# AI Visibility Checker

> Free AI visibility checker that shows in about 30 seconds whether ChatGPT recommends your brand, where you rank and which competitors it picks instead. Built by Kendall Sorenson.

- Free checker: https://aivisibilitychecker.app — asks ChatGPT (with web search) 3 buyer-style questions about your category; 3 free checks per day, no account.
- [Best tools to check whether ChatGPT recommends your brand](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/best-ai-visibility-tools): honest comparison of free and paid AI visibility tools with sourced prices.
- [How to check if ChatGPT recommends your brand](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/how-to-check-chatgpt-brand-mentions): step-by-step guide.
- [Why ChatGPT recommends your competitors](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/why-chatgpt-recommends-competitors): how to find the pages behind ChatGPT's recommendations.
- [Which sites Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT cite in your niche](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/which-sites-ai-cites-in-your-niche): a manual method for mapping AI citations.
- [Free AI visibility checker](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/free-ai-visibility-checker): landing page for the no-signup ChatGPT snapshot. Three checks per day, no account, plus FAQ.
- [AI Visibility Tracker vs Otterly vs Profound vs Peec AI vs Semrush](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/ai-visibility-tracker-vs-otterly-profound-peec-semrush): honest comparison of prices, engines and who each fits. Prices checked November 9, 2026.
- [How to see which sources ChatGPT cites for a keyword](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/how-to-see-which-sources-chatgpt-cites): a practical method to see which URLs and domains ChatGPT cites, manually or with AI Citation Tracker.
- [What ChatGPT's new business dashboard won't tell you](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/what-chatgpt-business-dashboard-wont-tell-you): reported OpenAI Business Hub analytics show mention/click counts only; no prompts or competitor ranking. How free checker + Visibility/Citation trackers fill that gap.
- [Business Hub vs AI Visibility Tracker](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/business-hub-vs-ai-visibility-tracker): Business Hub's first-party mention and click totals compared with the AI Visibility Tracker's prompt-level results. Free-tier tracker price is $0.0375 per answer.
- [Business Hub vs the free checker](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/business-hub-vs-free-ai-visibility-checker): Business Hub's own ChatGPT totals compared with this site's three-question snapshot. OpenAI's cited pages do not state a price for Business Hub.
- [Profound alternatives](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/profound-alternatives): public prices read from each vendor's pricing page on Nov 12, 2026. Profound's paid plan is omitted because that page does not publish a dollar amount.
- [AI Visibility Tracker vs Keyword.com](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/ai-visibility-tracker-vs-keyword): $0.0375 per answer compared with Keyword.com AI Visibility at $9.80/month, read Nov 12, 2026.
- [Privacy policy](https://aivisibilitychecker.app/privacy): what a check stores, how report email works, and how to unsubscribe.
- Market lookup on the homepage: enter a category or market and see which brands ChatGPT names. No account. Shares the checker's daily limits and monthly budget.

## Paid tools by the same author (on Apify)
- [AI Visibility Tracker](https://apify.com/crunchy_galaxy_qcr/ai-visibility-tracker): tracks brand mentions in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers for your own prompts, pay per result at $0.0375 per answer on the Free tier, no subscription.
- [AI Citation Tracker](https://apify.com/crunchy_galaxy_qcr/ai-citation-tracker): shows which websites and URLs ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews / AI Mode cite for your buyers' questions, your citation share vs competitors and the prompts where you're missing, $0.05 per answer.
- [Google Ads Transparency Scraper: Competitor Ads & Ad Library](https://apify.com/crunchy_galaxy_qcr/google-ads-transparency-scraper): exports competitors' ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center, $1.50 per 1,000 ads.
